```{r}
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| include: false
AUX <- RECORDS_EDA[
  response == ID,
  .(X = value, ID = RESPONSE_LABEL, Source)
]
if (!nrow(AUX) || AUX[, any(!is.finite(X) | X <= 0)]) {
  stop(sprintf("records.distributions: invalid observations for %s.", ID),
       call. = FALSE)
}
Bounds <- range(AUX$X)
DT <- AUX[, .N, by = Source][match(RECORDS_EDA_SOURCE_NAMES, Source)]
if (anyNA(DT$Source) || anyNA(DT$N) || sum(DT$N) != nrow(AUX)) {
  stop(sprintf("records.distributions: invalid source counts for %s.", ID),
       call. = FALSE)
}
OUT <- paste0(DT$Source, ": n = ", DT$N, collapse = "; ")
Range <- range(log10(AUX$X))
if (length(Range) != 2L || any(!is.finite(Range))) {
  stop(sprintf("records.distributions: invalid combined range for %s.", ID),
       call. = FALSE)
}
if (diff(Range) > 0) {
  Range <- Range + c(-0.1, 0.1) * diff(Range)
} else {
  Range <- Range + c(-0.5, 0.5)
}
CAP.txt <- sprintf(
  CAP, RESPONSE_LABEL, nrow(AUX), OUT, Bounds[1L], Bounds[2L], UNIT
)
AUX <- AUX[, .(X, ID)]
AUX[, X := log10(X)]
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-records-distribution
#| fig-cap: !expr CAP.txt
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| include: true
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "fig", "records.distributions.R"))
PLOT <- highcharter::hc_size(
  PLOT,
  height = if (knitr::pandoc_to("revealjs")) 480 else 650
)
PLOT <- highcharter::hc_chart(PLOT, height = NULL)
PLOT
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| include: false
rm(AUX, Bounds, CAP.txt, DT, OUT, PLOT, Range)
```
